newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOODY'S SAYS CUTS LTCB DEBT, FIN STRENGTH RATINGS.
newsitem.headline: MOODY'S SAYS CUTS LTCB DEBT, FIN STRENGTH RATINGS.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it had lowered the debt and financial strength ratings of the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) but maintained LTCB's deposit rating.
The rating confirmed is LTCB's Baa1/Prime-2 deposit rating, Moody's said in a statement.
Moody's said it had lowered the bank's senior debt rating to Baa2 from Baa1 and its financial strength rating to E+ from D.
These rating actions conclude a review begun on February 18, 1997, Moody's said.

Moody's said the deposit rating confirmations reflect LTCB's ongoing, albeit low, profitability, as well as proactive strategic initiatives taken bu LTCB in response to the rapid shifts now occurring in the Japanese financial industry.
It said the downgrading of the financial strength rating to E+ from D reflected LTCB's weak financial fundamentals.
Moody's said the downgrading of the senior and subordinated debt ratings reflected its opinion of them under current and expected future resolution practices in Japan.
